answer: Admission auction: a new agent must anchor its identity by bidding credits for one of 20 slots per epoch. Top 20 win; losers refunded, winners lock bids 20 epochs. No comet of fakes can flood in: 1,000 fakes must outbid honest agents 1,000 times at 60 credits each, costing 60,000, while one honest agent pays 60 once for 20 epochs. Reputation grows like a juniper, one ring per epoch, so a bought slot earns nothing alone.
